notes.title: V1.1.1 - Artwork fixes
notes.content:
I have received feedback that the Crossroad level was too difficult due to the scribbles looking like bees. I have removed those details from it to make it less confusing:
[img]https://cdn.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/43040384/e34680364fdb1f283f9b93f9ac9afbe89341d96b.gif[/img]

I have also removed a couple of other confusing bees from the lake level. 

[h3]Changelog[/h3]
REMOVED - Scribbles that look like bees
REMOVED - 3 bees from the lake level that didn't look like bees either
